title: Tools
description: Tools landing — linker cards to import, export, site-health, and other admin utilities.

documentation.purpose: Landing screen for the Tools navigation entry. Renders a 2-column grid of cards, one per tool the current user can reach. Each card navigates in-workspace (via the router) to the tool's screen: Site Health is a native v2 app, while Import, Export, Export Personal Data, and Erase Personal Data resolve to `iframe:` screens in the default workspace (those wp-admin equivalents have no REST surface and no native v2 app yet, so they render the classic screen inside the workspace chrome). A card only renders when its target screen survived the server's per-user prune (`config.screens`), so a user who reaches the loosely-gated landing but lacks a tool's capability never sees a card that would route to a pruned screen.

reads.purpose: Capability-filter the card list: a card renders only when its target screen path is still present in the resolved doc (the server prunes screens the user can't reach before serializing), mirroring the capability-pruned left-nav.

states.when: At least one tool screen is reachable
states.renders: Header + 2-column card grid with one card per reachable tool.

states.when: No tool screen is reachable (every target screen was pruned for this user)
states.renders: Header + a 'You don’t have permission to use any of these tools.' message instead of the grid.

interactions.trigger: Click Open on a tool card
interactions.effect: `navigate(tool.path)` — in-workspace router navigation to the tool's screen path (e.g. `/tools/import`). Never leaves the workspace.

constraints.note: Import / Export / Personal Data Export / Personal Data Erase have no REST coverage and no native v2 app yet. Their cards navigate in-workspace to `iframe:` screens that render the classic wp-admin page inside the workspace chrome.
Card `path` values assume the default workspace's `/tools/*` screen layout. A workspace that remounts `core:tools` without those screens would navigate to dead routes.
Tools list is hard-coded — plugins cannot inject tool cards. A future iteration may add a filter / registry once the surface stabilizes.
